content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to write an EIB object to an analogue output of a [product_name]? I am considering an application where a KNX controller could send a value to appear on a [product_name] analogue output, which would then control another device operating with a 0-10VDC signal. In this way, a [product_name] equipped with a [product_name] Communication Module could act as a KNX to 0-10VDC converter.

Hello, Yes, this can be done. Depending on the KNX/EIB version and the configuration of the [product_name], you are able to exchange up to 8 analogue values. The [product_name] itself supports up to 2 analogue outputs. I hope this answers your question.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the use of [product_name] Communication Modules to connect KNX/EIB networks to devices that require analog outputs. The exchange highlights interest in using [product_name] systems for building automation, specifically converting bus communications into analog voltages to control other equipment. Both technical possibilities and limitations of the module configurations are addressed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] Communication Modules to allow KNX/EIB objects to be written directly to [product_name] analogue outputs, facilitating integration of bus-based systems with analog-controlled devices.
